sync_law: 1. A product fact (price, tier name, perk list, link, spelling, mark) is born and changed ONLY in canon.json. Edit -> bump canon_version (semver) -> append a changelog entry.
2. Every change propagates in ONE wave to all four surfaces in the same work cycle; mirrors are re-stamped with the new version. No surface ever ships a value the Canon doesn't hold.
3. A surface disagreeing with the Canon is a bug ON THAT SURFACE, never on the Canon.
4. status 'proposed' prices may be promoted to 'sourced' ONLY by the owner. quote_only SKUs never gain a number.

5. `npm run canon:check` green is a promotion gate for the site; the bot's test suite (asserting canonical links/prices in registries) is the equivalent gate for the bot; the OBS lane validator + mirror stamp is the gate there.
standing_laws: CUHZ spelling: 'CUHZ Bot', 'Cuhzunity', members are 'cuhz'/'cuhzins'. ('Cuhz_Bot' is the bot's technical handle only.)

Honesty: no fake LIVE, no invented urgency/scarcity/discounts, no invented testimonials/numbers; prices only from deterministic code-owned sources; un-wired checkout fails with PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED (503) toast — never a fake sale.
Never touch /protocol or any VQNC surface.
Price discipline: every price SOURCED or flagged '[PROPOSED — owner adjust in DB]'; Architect is 'Contact for Quote', never a number.
--twitch purple scoped to Twitch OAuth + the live section only, always flat (never a gradient).

notes: TWO LADDERS NEVER TOUCH (from _CUHZBOT_STREAM_COMMERCE_PLAN.md §D): Planet CUHZ sells two separate ladders, and they never touch. Site membership — Free, Pro $9.99/mo, Team $24.99/mo — is about the Planet Cuhz platform: 2K tools, squad features, coaching perks. CUHZ Bot tiers — Community FREE, Silver Supporter $4.99/mo, Gold Executive $14.99/mo for viewers; Affiliate Pack $49.99/mo and the quote-only Architect build for streamers — are about power inside Twitch chat. Buying one never changes the other: in the database, bot tiers are recorded as their own entitlements (bot_silver/bot_gold/bot_affiliate) and deliberately write plan_tier: null, so a Gold Executive can be a Free site member and a Team subscriber can be Community in chat. Each surface reports only its own ladder. Engineered this way end-to-end (webhook, CHECK constraint, pricing page).

OBS PARALLEL OFFERING (WO-1 audit): the OBS `brands/cuhz-bot` lane holds a SEPARATE stream-services/agency storefront (Widget Starter Pack $29, Cuhz_Bot Starter $49, OBS Automation Bundle $79, Stream Store Website $149+, and a product_catalog.json of $19–$199 items). These are a different business line from the consumer SKUs below and are NOT governed by this canon. Reconciliation (if the agency offering should ever cite canon service bands) is owner-gated — not a Wave-2 task.

TWITCH CHANNEL is env-driven: src/components/live/LivePlayer.tsx builds https://www.twitch.tv/${VITE_TWITCH_CHANNEL}. Canonical value is 'planetcuhz' (owner sets VITE_TWITCH_CHANNEL). No literal twitch.tv/planetcuhz string in src is expected — this is not drift.
Bot viewer/streamer tiers carry plan_tier: null (orthogonal ladders). Only site memberships (pro/team) and legacy founders/assembly write a plan_tier.
